description:
lastSetFor returns a single row ordered by completedAt, so set 4 of today is compared against whatever was logged last, which is usually set 1 of the previous session. The delta shown during a workout is therefore comparing a late fatigued set against a fresh one, and reads as regression when nothing regressed.

Key the comparison on setNumber instead. Touches lastNumbers in the sessions route and the TodayExercise contract in @afya/shared, so web and api move together.
title: Compare against the matching set number, not the most recent set
